# annealer

> Reorders HTML/Vue attributes by semantic meaning using swappable YAML profiles.

## Guide

- [Introduction](/annealer/guide/start/introduction.md): What annealer is, why attribute order matters, how it relates to vue/attributes-order, and what is in and out of scope.
- [Getting started](/annealer/guide/start/getting-started.md): Run annealer from the anyl CLI or from JavaScript, and choose a built-in or custom profile.
- [Attribute order](/annealer/guide/concepts/attribute-order.md): How annealer tokenizes start tags, classifies attributes into groups, clusters same-name attributes, respects v-bind spreads, and normalizes names.
- [Stylesheets](/annealer/guide/concepts/stylesheets.md): How annealer orders declarations in CSS, SCSS, Sass and Less through malva, where vendor-prefixed declarations go, and the opt-in style attribute support.
- [Layout](/annealer/guide/features/layout.md): Layout rules for multiline start tags, self-closing elements and element content, equivalent to the matching eslint-plugin-vue rules.
- [Disable directives](/annealer/guide/features/disable-directives.md): Comments that switch annealer off for a region or for the next line, in markup and in stylesheets.
- [Value ordering](/annealer/guide/design/value-ordering.md): Planned ordering of tokens inside static class attributes, defined by library-specific profiles such as Tailwind and Bootstrap.
- [Library profiles](/annealer/guide/design/library-profiles.md): Planned library-specific profiles, and the agreed policy for discovering them in a project's dependencies.
- [Design decisions](/annealer/guide/design/decisions.md): Architecture of annealer and the design decisions made during implementation, with their reasons.

## API

- [API Overview](/annealer/api/index.md): Entry points to annealer, the anyl CLI, the JavaScript API, and the YAML profile format.
- [CLI](/annealer/api/cli.md): Options, input languages and exit codes of the anyl command-line tool.
- [JavaScript API](/annealer/api/javascript.md): The annealer npm package, format(), init(), languageFromPath(), builtinProfile() and the exported types.
- [Profile reference](/annealer/api/profile.md): Reference for the annealer profile YAML format, with every key, its type and its default.
